technical.summary: Strong short-term bullish confluence with Ichimoku cross-up and three white soldiers, but overbought conditions (stoch/RSI/Williams) and weak trend strength (ADX 11.59) limit conviction; price below 200-SMA suggests intermediate downtrend.

fundamental.summary: WST shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 29 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (39.9%); insufficient data to establish conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (200.8) combined with inverted yield curve and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 29 days adds moderate event risk but is secondary to acute market stress.

debate.key_bull_argument: Ichimoku cloud cross-up with three white soldiers and 15x volume spike create strong short-term bullish confluence at support (247.14), offering defined risk entry for swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (stoch/RSI/Williams), price below 200-SMA, weak ADX (11.59), zero fundamental support, VIX crisis (200.8), inverted yield curve, and earnings risk in 29 days create a hostile macro environment that overwhelms technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows Ichimoku cross-up with three white soldiers and 15x volume spike at support, offering defined risk entry. However, overbought oscillators, price below 200-SMA, weak trend strength (ADX 11.59), and zero fundamental support severely limit conviction.
